title: skill-evals: a trigger turn installs only its own bundle, so it cannot measure description competition or move off the should-load ceiling
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1ZJL93Kin2UHFXbFv

Filing gate ②: an instrument gap found by the #34769 measurement round (a4-A, PR #35857), filed on the seat's ruling (seat 4, 2026-11-20 12:47Z). Dedupe: searched `skill-evals trigger competing bundles install`. No open card; #35705 (the `--triggers-only` flag, merged) is a different gap.

Suggested-grade: p2. It blocks the Done-when of #34769 (p2). Trigger-rate measurement of any skill description change depends on it.

## What

A `skill-evals` trigger turn (`should_trigger` case) runs in a directory where only the case's own bundle is installed. Round `/mnt/project-files/area-ai-seat/a4-A/evals/34769-triggers-20261120/` (haiku, effort medium, `--triggers-only`; before `--skills-from 18.6.0`, after #35857's branch) shows three consequences:

1. Should-load rates sit at the ceiling whatever the description says: 28/28 finished turns before, 29/30 after, on the same 30 should-load cases. A description change cannot show a "measurably higher" rate.
2. Bundle-against-bundle competition is invisible. `objectstack-query` trigger case 3 is a business question over MCP that `objectstack-ask` also claims, and the runner cannot show which bundle wins. A 12-turn head-to-head outside the runner, with both bundles installed, found ask launched 12/12 and query 0/12. Raw streams are under `s1-head-to-head/` in the round.
3. Every false load seen (5/12 before, 4/12 after) is a small model searching the near-empty directory and opening the only skill file it finds (read-only load). That measures the empty room, not the description.

## Ask

Give trigger turns a realistic competing set:
- install the whole selected catalog, or at least a declared set of neighbour bundles per case, into every trigger turn;
- grade a should-load case as passed only when its own bundle loads, and record which other bundles loaded;
- record the installed set in `round.json` so `--regrade` keeps it.

Keep `--triggers-only` working, and keep the round cost per turn unchanged.

## Done when

On the six metadata bundles plus `objectstack-ask`, a `--triggers-only --dry-run` shows each trigger turn installing the competing set. The self-test has a fixture where a should-load case fails because a neighbour bundle loaded instead.

Relations: blocks the re-measurement of #34769. Lane: eval tooling (`packages/qa/scenarios`).
